title: Claude Opus 4.5 joins the text models
summary:
Claude Opus 4.5 and Nano Banana Pro joined the model lineup, chat validation got less fussy, and three community projects joined the listings.

Claude Opus 4.5 was added as `claude-large`, with image input and tool support. The `claude` name now selects Sonnet 4.5, while `claude-fast` selects Haiku 4.5. Bedrock models also default to 16,384 max tokens unless a request specifies otherwise.

`nanobanana-pro` adds Gemini 3 Pro Image to the image model registry, using the existing Nano Banana generation path and its width and height controls. Its registry description lists 4K images and Thinking support.

Chat completion validation now accepts provider-specific finish reasons in regular and streaming responses, plus assistant messages with missing content. Responses from non-OpenAI providers no longer have to pretend they use OpenAI's exact schema.

highlights.title: Claude Opus 4.5 added
highlights.text: Use `claude-large` for Claude Opus 4.5 with image input and tools. `claude` now selects Sonnet 4.5; Haiku 4.5 is available as `claude-fast`. [Browse Claude Opus 4.5](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-large).

highlights.title: Nano Banana Pro added
highlights.text: Generate images with Gemini 3 Pro Image using `nanobanana-pro`, with width and height controls through the existing Nano Banana path. [Browse Nano Banana Pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-pro).
